scope: F-006 bind selected visual events and their actual extracted frames to the ordinary semantic-analysis input

historical_failure_source.failure_point: The preserved server built eventLog, but OllamaVideoAnalysisProvider.analyzeFrames received recordingName, durationSeconds, frames, textPassages, and additionalFocus without the selected eventLog. The current analyzer had no ordinary semantic consumer or input artifact at all.

pre_fix_reproduction.failure: ENOENT: semantic-input.json did not exist after a successful ordinary analyzer run

implementation.ordinary_path_changed: processVideo now always prepares, persists, returns, and readback-verifies semantic-input.json.
bound_fields: extracted JPEG relative path and SHA-256
implementation.semantic_guard: Selected pixel, motion, or OCR activity remains semantic_interpretation=not_determined; the payload does not claim what the image means.
implementation.readback_enforcement: Package verification rejects missing or digest-mismatched semantic input, mismatched source identity or coverage, selection divergence, unresolved OCR references, missing/out-of-package frames, and frame SHA-256 mismatches.

after_payload_evidence.fixture_kind: deterministic decoded MP4 built from checked-in screen-state fixture images

known_failure.test: ASR preserves tested connector words and negation with versioned word timestamps
known_failure.expected: i do not think this is fair because you know the answer
known_failure.actual: i do not think this is there because you know the answer

evidence_boundary.reason_model_not_invoked: The current analyzer contains no semantic model provider. F-006 adds the smallest missing ordinary-consumer input interface without choosing or introducing a provider.
evidence_boundary.claim: F-006 proves that selected events and their verified frame/OCR/source evidence reach the normal persisted semantic-consumer boundary. It does not prove model interpretation quality or a later claim-release gate.

conclusion: F-006 passes for the bounded ordinary semantic-input contract. Selected events no longer stop at evidence selection: the normal analyzer package includes readback-verified frame bytes, source identity, true timestamps, OCR references, reasons, coverage, and uncertainty. No production integration or deployment occurred.
